messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing intermittent packet loss + reordering between pods on the gpu-east-2 nodepool. Affecting inference tail latencies and some streaming RPCs.
ajay: Symptoms? client timeouts, packet drops, or high retransmits?
maria: tail latency spikes and dropped streams. kube-proxy logs show connection resets. tcpdump on node shows sequence gaps and retransmits. quick snippet:
```
13:24:03.123 IP 10.32.5.6.50022 > 10.32.7.12.443: Flags [.], seq 12345:12800, ack 5678, win 28960, length 455
13:24:03.124 IP 10.32.5.6.50022 > 10.32.7.12.443: Flags [.], seq 12800:13255, ack 5678, length 455 (reordered)
13:24:03.130 IP 10.32.5.6.50022 > 10.32.7.12.443: Flags [R], seq ...
```
devon: Probable MTU/encap overhead mismatch — geneve adds ~50 bytes. What's `ip link` MTU on the underlay + tunnel across nodes?
maria: Host MTU is 1500, geneve0 MTU shows 1448 on some nodes and 1450 on others. Suspect inconsistent MTU set after autoscaling/provisioning.
jia: Also check NIC offloads. `ethtool -k` shows gso:on gro:on tso:on on the mlx5 parts. Offloads + tunnels have known reordering corner cases.
ajay: mlx5 + tunnel + GSO/GRO can reassemble weirdly. Quick test: disable on tunnel: `ethtool -K geneve0 gro off gso off tso off` and rerun the load.
maria: did that on node-05; saw the spike disappear for ~20m but it returned later. The incidents line up with bursty pod scale-ups.
devon: Could be NIC queue overrun during the burst. Are these nodes using hostDevice for GPUs? Any RDMA in play? Could be QP exhaustion or driver-level backpressure.
maria: GPUs use host-device; RDMA not used by inference processes, but overall egress on the NIC is high during batch workloads. Also saw `netdev_queue` drops in dmesg on a couple nodes.
netops-bot: Note: scheduled nodepool rolling maintenance for gpu-east-2 at 04:00 UTC.
jia: Also validate iptables/nft offload interactions. Offloading checksumming plus encap can produce checksum mismatches that lead to kernel drops. `nft list ruleset` + `ethtool -k` to confirm.
ajay: Additional tweaks to try while we debug: increase netdev backlog `sysctl -w net.core.netdev_max_backlog=50000`, increase NIC ring buffers `ethtool -G <dev> rx 4096 tx 4096`, and standardize tunnel MTU: `ip link set geneve0 mtu 1400` cluster-wide.
maria: Starting a canary with `mtu 1400` on one node now.
devon: If that helps, we should bake a kubelet/node-init that computes `ip link set dev $TUN mtu $((HOST_MTU - ENCAP_OVERHEAD))` and also optionally disable GSO on the tunnel via cloud-init.
maria: Running infer-bench load for 30m on canary and collecting metrics + pcap.
ajay: Also collect `ethtool -S`, `dmesg`, and `sar -n DEV` from affected nodes for filing upstream. This reads like a driver/kernel corner case — file a kernel/driver bug if we can reproduce.
maria: Uploading artifacts: /tmp/gpu-east-2-artifacts.tar.gz -> http://artifacts.internal/1767890123
devon: I temporarily disabled the autoscaler burst policy for this pool to avoid making the bursts worse.
maria: Canary (mtu 1400 + GSO off on geneve) has been stable for 45m with steady tail latencies. Rolling to 10% of pool now.
jia: If it recurs, capture pcaps on both ends: `tcpdump -w /tmp/geneve.pcap -i geneve0 not port 22` and upload. Also capture `ip -s link` across time.
netops-bot: Alert policy: auto-escalate if >5% nodes impacted in last 15m.
ajay: Agreed remediation: 1) enforce consistent MTU in base image, 2) kubelet node-init to set tunnel MTU, 3) document ethtool offload policy for mlx5 + tunnels, 4) add netdev drop monitors to console dashboards, 5) file kernel/driver issue if we can capture reliable repro. I'll draft RFC.
maria: Thanks. Will monitor 6h and post final remediation plan. :thumbsup:
